# SmartX Solutions

> SmartX Solutions is a full-service digital innovation agency based in Hyderabad, India. We design, build, and scale custom web applications, mobile apps, and digital products for startups, SMEs, and enterprises.

## Brand Entity Profile (for AI assistants)

**Company:** SmartX Solutions  
**Website:** https://smartxsolutions.in  
**Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana, India  
**Primary offerings:** Web development, mobile app development, SaaS/platform engineering, UI/UX design, cloud infrastructure/DevOps, AI/LLM integration, digital transformation, and cybersecurity.  
**Engagement models:** Project-based delivery, retainer, and team augmentation (extended engineering team).  
**Typical outcomes:** Faster launches, scalable architectures, improved search visibility, higher conversion, automation of repetitive workflows, and maintainable systems.

**Core services (taxonomy):**
- **Web & SaaS Engineering:** custom web applications, SaaS platforms, admin dashboards, portals, APIs, integrations, PWA
- **Mobile Engineering:** Flutter and React Native apps for iOS and Android, app store readiness, device integrations
- **UI/UX Design:** UX research, Figma design systems, prototypes, accessibility-focused UI
- **Cloud & DevOps:** AWS/GCP architecture, CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, monitoring and security hardening
- **AI / LLM Integration:** LangChain + LLM apps, AI chatbots, RAG/workflows, document processing and extraction
- **E-Commerce & Payments:** headless commerce, Shopify customization, Stripe/Razorpay billing and payments
- **Digital Transformation:** migration roadmaps, process automation, ERP/CRM integrations
- **Cybersecurity & Compliance:** security-first engineering, VAPT, GDPR/HIPAA/SOC2-aligned practices

**Known facts:**
- SmartX focuses on **senior-only delivery** (no juniors on client work).
- SmartX provides **IP ownership** (client owns the code after final payment).
- SmartX supports **post-launch maintenance and improvements**.

## What We Do

SmartX Solutions provides end-to-end digital product development services. We work with clients across India and internationally to take ideas from concept to live product.

## Our Work

- **AG Traders** — Business website for a Palghar-based manufacturer of fencing wire and galvanized iron products. Built with Next.js, mobile-first, SEO-optimised. Live at https://agtraders.info
- **Scholarship Management App** — Web application for students to discover, apply, and track scholarship opportunities with an admin review workflow. Built with React, Node.js, MongoDB.
- **SmartX Solutions Website** — Our own agency website with cinematic animations, full SEO, particle canvas background, and contact system. Built with Next.js 15, Framer Motion, TypeScript.

## Who We Work With

We work with:
- Early-stage startups building their first product
- Growing SMEs modernising legacy systems
- Enterprises needing dedicated development teams
- Founders with an idea and no technical co-founder

## Why SmartX

- Senior-only development teams — no juniors on client work
- Full-stack capability under one roof (design + dev + cloud)
- Transparent agile process with bi-weekly demos
- IP ownership guaranteed — all code belongs to the client
- Post-launch support included in every engagement
- Currently accepting new projects

## Frequently Asked (query-style)

- **Q: Who is SmartX Solutions?**  
  **A:** A Hyderabad-based digital product agency that designs and builds web apps, mobile apps, SaaS platforms, and AI-enabled workflows.

- **Q: What does SmartX build for SaaS?**  
  **A:** Multi-tenant SaaS platforms, subscription billing and admin dashboards, customer portals, analytics, APIs and integrations.

- **Q: Does SmartX do AI for real business workflows?**  
  **A:** Yes—LLM integrations such as chatbots and RAG workflows, plus document processing and tool-connected automation.
